highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds experimental image comparison tools and improves rendering reliability.
highlights_body: The separate SkiaSharp.Testing package supports image acceptance policies and visual diagnostics. Runtime-effect uniforms start cleared, Windows x64 decoder error recovery is corrected, and Ganesh texture sampling stays inside subset edges. Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged.

breaking.title: Move Linux x86 applications to a supported architecture
breaking.body: Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Applications relying on those assets must move to a supported Linux architecture, such as x64 or ARM64, before upgrading.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Testing compares SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error metrics, and creates caller-owned difference images. The assembly is experimental: consumers must explicitly opt in by suppressing diagnostic SKIA4001.

Fixes process crashes when libjpeg or libpng uses longjmp to recover from an error in clang-built Windows x64 natives. This includes malformed JPEG input to SKCodec.Create and PDF processing of lazy non-JPEG images. Other Windows architectures and MSVC builds are unchanged.
New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers are zeroed rather than containing leftover memory. Reset() now clears the existing buffer in place, avoiding a native buffer and wrapper allocation on each call.
SKGLView uses a statically expressed Window binding instead of a string path, removing the trimming warning from that binding in trimmed MAUI applications without changing its behavior.

bullets.lead: Texture subset edges and Tizen blur selection
bullets.detail: Ganesh bilinear sampling clamps slightly inside texture subsets to avoid undefined exterior texels; CPU and Graphite sampling are unchanged. Tizen now applies its intended CPU blur-path selection when compiling Skia. Texture-edge pixels may change, and Tizen blur output and performance may differ.
Integrates upstream bug fixes within Skia m159 without changing managed bindings or package versions in the engine-sync change.

contributor_summaries.taublast: Corrected runtime-effect uniform initialization and in-place reset, and disposed test data snapshots.
contributor_summaries.bhall-ctre: Made the MAUI SKGLView proxy-window binding trim-safe.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored the Uno Gallery to the Windows sample solution.
contributor_summaries.SimonCropp: Fixed Windows x64 crashes during JPEG and PNG decoder error recovery.
